Introduction.SourceString: 看起来不太好惹实际也不太好惹的伊波恩一霸。
Introduction.LocalizedString: Unrivaled at Eibon and as scary as she looks.

Content.SourceString:
妨碍伊波恩店长浔发财梦的主要因素，除了店长本人的问题，最绕不开的自然是「伊波恩王牌三人组（自称）」每次委托后逃不掉的赔偿金，尤其是被早雾搞坏的。「鬼郎丸」吞下去的都是小问题，要是早雾火大了抡起「鬼郎丸」，那简直……
当然，干出这种事的早雾也免不了被浔一顿训，不过从伊波恩每个月的账单和阿德勒皱起的眉头来看，效果怕是不尽如人意。

尽管每次早雾出任务都会给伊波恩带来这样那样的麻烦，但要是让她闲在店里……
上一秒还在看《周刊Fantasy》，下一秒没准就拿着漫画里的场景开始让娜娜莉带自己出去找乐，咳咳，建设柯林斯家族；要是没跟着娜娜莉出去找事，那遭殃的恐怕就是塔吉多；就算哪天早雾破天荒地安安生生待在店里，「鬼郎丸」也能创造些「意外惊喜」出来……

早雾走到哪，麻烦就好像跟到哪，但又不像娜娜莉，早雾从不会捅出大篓子，关键时刻还能拉娜娜莉一把。虽然柯林斯家族看起来是娜娜莉在拉着早雾和埃德嘉跑东跑西，但真的算起来……或许早雾才是最靠谱的那个？

对了，如果不想吃「鬼郎丸」的「大记忆修正术」的话，切记切记，不要对早雾每天偷偷摸摸扔掉的东西感兴趣，否则……
Content.LocalizedString:
The main obstacles to Eibon owner Hotori's dreams of getting rich are, aside from the owner's own issues, the unavoidable compensation fees after every commission from the "Eibon Ace Trio (self-proclaimed)," especially for things Sakiri breaks. What Kiroumaru swallows is small stuff, but when Sakiri gets really mad and swings Kiroumaru around, well…
Of course, Sakiri gets a good scolding from Hotori for pulling stunts like that, but judging from Eibon's monthly bills and Adler's furrowed brow, the effect probably isn't great.

Even though Sakiri brings all sorts of trouble to Eibon every time she goes on quests, if you leave her idle in the shop…
One second she's reading "Weekly Fantasy," the next she might grab some scene from the manga and get Nanally to take her out for fun, ahem, building The Coluccis. If she doesn't follow Nanally out to cause trouble, then poor Taygedo gets it instead. And even if Sakiri miraculously stays put in the shop for once, Kiroumaru can still create some accidents…

Trouble seems to follow Sakiri wherever she goes, but unlike Nanally, Sakiri never causes major disasters and can even bail Nanally out when it counts. While it looks like Nanally is the one dragging Sakiri and Edgar around everywhere for The Coluccis, when you really think about it… maybe Sakiri is actually the most reliable one?

Oh, and if you don't want to get hit with Kiroumaru's "Memory Correction Technique," remember this well: don't get curious about the things Sakiri sneakily throws away every day, or else…

Content.SourceString:
柯林斯家族一代目亲自认证，做大做强，再创辉煌的中流砥柱！
「早雾！埃德嘉！我又想到了有关家族建设的新计划！」
「不是吧，又来？要不我们趁现在跑吧？」
「要是不听的话……娜娜莉下次还要继续讲的……」
「饶了我吧……」
「来！这将是决定柯林斯家族命运的一次会议！」
Content.LocalizedString:
Personally certified by the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis, the cornerstone of growing bigger, getting stronger, and reaching new heights!
"Sakiri! Edgar! I just thought of a new plan for the family!"
"Seriously? Again? Should we make a run for it while we can?"
"If we don't listen… Nanally's gonna keep going on about it next time…"
"Give me a break…"
"Come on! This'll be the meeting that decides the Coluccis' fate!"

Content.SourceString:
「噗呲噗呲，埃德嘉，上次早雾吃了『诚实跳跳糖』之后到底说了啥？塔吉多说我错过了一出好戏！」
「那个……早雾不让说……」
「哎呀没事的，早雾现在不……」
「呆子！跟娜娜莉叽里咕噜的说啥呢！该干活了鬼郎丸！」
「别别别别别别！我还什么都不知道啊啊啊啊啊！」
Content.LocalizedString:
"Hehe, Edgar, what exactly did Sakiri say after she ate that Honest Popping Candy last time? Taygedo said I missed quite a show!"
"Um… Sakiri told me not to say…"
"Oh come on, it's fine, Sakiri's not…"
"Dummy! What are you whispering about with Nanally?! Time to get to work, Kiroumaru!"
"No no no no no no! I don't know anything yet!"

Content.SourceString:
仿佛生来就是为了吃的异象，食物要吃，收音机要吃，自行车圈要吃，轮胎也要吃，吃吃吃吃吃吃吃吃吃！
早雾，这个可以吃吗？早雾，那个可以吃吗？
总之，只要能在早雾身边吃吃吃就好！一直跟着早雾，吃吃吃！
Content.LocalizedString:
An Anomaly that seems born just to eat! It eats food, it eats radios, it eats bike wheels, it eats tires, eat eat eat eat eat eat eat eat eat!
"Sakiri, can I eat this? Sakiri, can I eat that?"
Anyway, as long as it can stay by Sakiri's side and eat eat eat, it's happy! Always following Sakiri around, eat eat eat!

Content.SourceString:
少有人听过的旋律，早雾从不在人前哼起这段童谣。
对平日里有些过于成熟的她来说，这是她少有的，表现地像一个孩子的时候。
尽管早雾总是闭口不谈，但或许我们能从这段歌谣里窥见一二——
从这段，孤独且诡异的歌谣中，看到她过去的一些影子。
Content.LocalizedString:
A melody few have ever heard, Sakiri never hums this nursery rhyme in front of others.
For someone who acts too mature for her age most of the time, this is one of those rare moments when she actually shows her inner child.
Though Sakiri always keeps quiet about it, perhaps we can glimpse something from this song…
From this lonely and eerie nursery rhyme, we might see some hints of her past.

Content.SourceString:
「月光当铺」事件结尾，奥托送给早雾的礼物，一个装着伊波恩成员样式小熊的盒子。
偶尔早雾会藏在房间里把小熊拿出来把玩，被小熊们围着，像是过家家一样。
尽管从没有说出口，但她很喜欢这份礼物。
Content.LocalizedString:
At the end of the "Pawn Moonlight" incident, Otro gave Sakiri a gift: a box containing little bears designed to look like Eibon members.
Sometimes Sakiri hides in her room and takes out the bears to play with them, surrounded by the little figures like she's playing house.
Though she's never said it out loud, she really loves this gift.

Content.SourceString:
（鬼郎丸：你好，我是坏脾气的早雾，这位是无敌的鬼郎丸大人——哎哟！）
你就是浔拐来做鉴定的家伙？喏，看到啦，记得提防这个叫鬼郎丸的丑八怪，别靠得太近……要是什么东西不见了，我可不负责帮你掏出来……屁股被咬了也没有医药费！
Content.LocalizedString:
(Kiroumaru: Hello, I'm the ever-so-grumpy Sakiri, and this is the invincible Lord Kiroumaru—ouch!) 
So you're the appraiser Hotori picked up? There, be careful around that ugly monster Kiroumaru, don't get too close… If something goes missing, I won't help you find it… No insurance if you get bitten on the butt either!

Content.SourceString: 鬼郎丸！又在乱吃东西！给我吐出来！
Content.LocalizedString: Kiroumaru! What's that junk you're eating? Spit it out!

Content.SourceString:
啪嚓、啪嚓，到底在哪里呀；
可爱又易碎的，玻璃娃娃。
滴答、滴答，太阳已经落下；
回到大家身边，不再害怕。
Content.LocalizedString:
Snap, snap, where did you go?
Fragile and cute, that glass doll.
Tick-tock, tick-tock, the sun's dipped low.
Safe with the crew, fears all stowed.

Content.SourceString: 都还没起来吧……咕咕咕……呃……果然还是习惯不了牛奶的味道……
Content.LocalizedString: Still sleeping, eh… Glug glug glug… Ugh, I can't stand milk…

Content.SourceString: 叫上娜娜莉一起把呆子抓出去找乐…干大事吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Let's drag Nanally and the dummy out for some… something big!

Content.SourceString: 再有不长眼的车敢把水溅到我头上就死定了！
Content.LocalizedString: Another car splashes me, it's done for!

Content.SourceString: 我才不要穿得跟毛线球一样，丑死了……阿、阿嚏！
Content.LocalizedString: I won't dress like an ugly yarn ball… Ah, achoo!

Content.SourceString: 小熊棒冰……哼，幼稚鬼才会喜欢的东西……
Content.LocalizedString: Little bear popsicle? Please, that's kid stuff…

Content.SourceString: 怎么现在才来啊！太阳都晒屁股了！
Content.LocalizedString: What took you so long?! The sun's been up for hours!

Content.SourceString: 喂，看我好心陪你这么久，是不是该表示下感谢？
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, I've been here for you all day, maybe show some gratitude?

Content.SourceString: 在太阳落山的一瞬间眨眼——就会被影子鬼吃掉！……骗你的~
Content.LocalizedString: If you blink at the moment the sun goes down, you'll get—snagged by the shadow ghost!… Haha, just kidding!

Content.SourceString: 诶？这就准备去睡觉了？真没劲！……明天记得早点来！
Content.LocalizedString: Off to dreamland already? You're so boring… Come earlier tomorrow, okay?

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多跳脚的样子别提多好笑啦！只要把冰箱里他的零食一口气全吃掉，或者把他收集的宝贝卡贴都藏起来，反正他放来放去，还不是那些没创意的地方！……这个怎么不能算是爱好？交流交流感情懂不懂？
Content.LocalizedString: Seeing Taygedo rage is priceless! Just eat all his snacks from the fridge, or hide his precious sticker cards. After all, he always hides them in the same uncreative places! …How is this not a hobby? It's called "bonding," got it?

Content.SourceString: 可恶，喝了一年了还是没有长高……阿德勒大骗子……
Content.LocalizedString: Still not taller after drinking this stuff for a year… Adler's a liar…

Content.SourceString: 给我买了零食？哼哼，那我就勉强收下吧。……跳跳糖？……是谁告诉了你之前诚实跳跳糖的事情？好哇，想抵赖也没用！是选自己忘掉，还是我用鬼郎丸帮你做个物理失忆手术？
Content.LocalizedString: Snacks for me? Hmph, I'll reluctantly accept them. …Popping candy? …Who told you about the honest popping candy? Well, no use denying it! Forget it yourself, or shall I have Kiroumaru surgically remove that memory for you?

Content.SourceString: 不是什么了不得的事情，将人类和异象相结合，人的力量战胜异象，就成为失格种，异象的力量战胜人类，就变成更劣等的东西，好死不死地活着……这是什么眼神？……话先说在前头，我可不会输给那些低级的家伙！要是再有什么「真可怜」之类的想法，就离我远一些。
Content.LocalizedString: It's not a big deal. When a human and an anomaly merge, if the human overcomes the anomaly, they become a Disqualified Spawn. If the anomaly overcomes the human, they become something even more inferior, living miserably… What's with that look?… Just to make it clear, I'm not about to be bested by those bottom-rung beings! So, if you're pitying me, you might as well step back.

Content.SourceString: 空瓶？什、什么牛奶空瓶！……你看错了，只有鬼郎丸才喝得下气味那么奇怪的东西。
Content.LocalizedString: W…what? Empty milk bottles?! You must be seeing things… That's Kiroumaru's weird taste, not mine, definitely.

Content.SourceString:
是有多倒霉才能被鬼郎丸这样的家伙缠上？爱唱反调、吵得要死！记不清因为它乱吃东西收拾了多少烂摊子！每次闹肚子还吐的到处都是！
（鬼郎丸：世事皆一口，暴食即正义~）
闭——嘴——！总有一天我要把你这张嘴缝起来！
Content.LocalizedString:
How unlucky do you have to be to get stuck with someone like Kiroumaru? Always defiant and noisy! I can't count how many times I've cleaned up its mess because it eats everything! And when it gets an upset stomach, it vomits everywhere!
(Kiroumaru: Everything's on the menu! Gluttony rules!)
Zip—it—! One day I'll sew that mouth shut!

Content.SourceString: 问这个干什么？是不是那两个多管闲事的家伙又说了什么？……哼，乱猜也没用，我才不要告诉你。
Content.LocalizedString: Curious, are we? Did those two meddlers say something?… Hmph. Save the guesswork. These lips are sealed.

Content.SourceString: 败家、好吃懒做的酒鬼！爱给人添麻烦，还幼稚得要死！我平时、那是都让着她，才不跟她一般见识！
Content.LocalizedString: She's a lazy squanderer! Always stirring the pot and acting like a child! I was just showing my kindness to her everyday!

Content.SourceString: 要不是阿德勒在，伊波恩早就破产八百回了吧！每天还要费力照顾一帮不靠谱的，有这个心力，不如也多关心关心自己！
Content.LocalizedString: If Adler wasn't around, Eibon would've gone bankrupt ages ago! Taking care of the flaky bunch is a full-time gig. Why not care for yourself for a change?!

Content.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔的实力，就连我也是认可的，成年人就是要有她那样的身手才像个样子！不过跟她一起出委托可是会把人憋出问题来的，感觉搭档了一座冰雕！我看——噗……她和呆子最适合被安排在一起！
Content.LocalizedString: Daffodill's got moves, and I respect that. But teaming up with her? It's like a breath-holding contest with a statue. Ha… I bet she'd vibe with that dummy, Edgar!

Content.SourceString: 悄悄告诉你，如果你想看到娜娜莉抱着自己的尾巴缩成一团的样子，一盘恐怖片就行了。只要稍微激她一下，她肯定会立刻答应一起看的！嘿嘿，还不快去试试？记住别说是我告诉你的啊！
Content.LocalizedString: Psst, wanna see Nanally freak out? Put on a horror film, and she'll be hugging her tail in no time. Go on, dare her—but don't say I gave you the idea!

Content.SourceString: 这个闷葫芦，那么聪明有什么用，有什么要说的，常常支支吾吾半天也放不出一声响……啧，果然还得靠我！不过别看他那个磨蹭的样子，一旦到了能发挥他能力的时候，没点心理准备的人可是会大吃一惊的！
Content.LocalizedString: Being a brainiac is great and all, but if he's too shy to speak up, what's the point? So yeah, I'm the one who steps up! But let me tell you, don't let that quiet act fool you. When it's go-time, he'll come out swinging and leave everyone's jaws on the floor!

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉跟呆子，一个笨蛋，一个闷葫芦，跟他们两个待在一起真的是要累死人了！要是没了我，谁知道他们两个会怎么样？不，不过，跟他们待在一起我也……不讨厌就是了……
Content.LocalizedString: Ah, Nanally and the dummy, what a pair! One's scatterbrained, the other's tight-lipped. What would they do without me? But guess what? I… don't hate their company…

Content.SourceString: 全桥间地最笨的歧骸！从来认不清上下级关系！他这种笨海獭，最多只能是我的小弟好不好？还动不动就哭鼻子，真是丢脸！嗯……不过想了下，要是没了塔吉多，日子果然会很无聊呢……我还是勉为其难，让他跟在身边吧！
Content.LocalizedString: The dumbest oddity in the entire Bridge Crossings! Never understands the hierarchy! That dumb otter can only be my sidekick, okay? And he cries at the drop of a hat, so embarrassing! Hmm… but you know what, life would be boring without Taygedo… I guess he can stick around!

Content.SourceString: 自以为是，高高在上的家伙，上次我就该下手再重一些！不过我大人有大量，看在他们戴罪立功，认错态度良好的份上，就先不算那笔帐了。
Content.LocalizedString: Those self-righteous, high-and-mighty guys, I should have hit 'em harder last time! But I'm all about second chances, especially when they're trying to make things right. So, I'll let bygones be bygones… for now.

Content.SourceString: 哼，我只是、暂时没有想到更合心意的去处，想到阿德勒做饭好吃，暂时留在这里帮忙罢了……
Content.LocalizedString: Humph, I haven't found anywhere else that feels quite satisfying. Plus, Adler's cooking? That's reason enough to stay and lend a hand…

Content.SourceString: 这种程度，姑且算是过关吧。
Content.LocalizedString: It's barely passable.

Content.SourceString: 照这么下去，都不是我的对手~
Content.LocalizedString: At this rate, they'll never catch up with me!

Content.SourceString: 鬼郎丸的胃口怎么越来越大了……
Content.LocalizedString: How is Kiroumaru's appetite growing?

Content.SourceString: 哇，你怎么知……咳咳，算你有心，我会记住的！
Content.LocalizedString: Wow, how did you…? Ahem, I'll remember you tried this hard!

Content.SourceString: 难道说你犯了什么事，想让鬼郎丸帮你掩护一下？尽管开口，包在它嘴里！
Content.LocalizedString: Did you want Kiroumaru to cover a mistake you made? Just name it! Kiroumaru will deal with it!

Content.SourceString: 谢啦，我会看住鬼郎丸不让它吃下去的——呃，至少在我睡觉之前。
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks. I'll make sure Kiroumaru doesn't eat it—Umm, at least before I sleep.

Content.SourceString: 改天还你个惊喜，当然是正经的！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll give you a surprise some day. I legit one!

Content.SourceString: 开饭咯！
Content.LocalizedString: Time to eat!

Content.SourceString: 统统打飞！
Content.LocalizedString: Knock them all away!

Content.SourceString: 嘿咿呀！(呀吼！)
Content.LocalizedString: Hey yah! (Yahoo!)

Content.SourceString: 抓住他们，鬼郎丸！
Content.LocalizedString: Get 'em, Kiroumaru!

Content.SourceString: 笨蛋别被砸到咯~
Content.LocalizedString: Watch out, fools!

Content.SourceString: 注意脚下~（抓到咯！）
Content.LocalizedString: Watch your step… (Gotcha!)

Content.SourceString: 鬼郎丸，干正事了！
Content.LocalizedString: Kiroumaru! Let's get down to business!

Content.SourceString: 姑且算你干得不错，这玩意给你了。
Content.LocalizedString: Hmph, decent work! You can have that now.

Content.SourceString: 切，还以为会闹得更大一些……
Content.LocalizedString: Tch, thought there would be more chaos…

Content.SourceString: 这就结束了吗？没劲。
Content.LocalizedString: Is it over? Boring.

Content.SourceString: 偶尔也能带点有用的东西回来嘛，鬼郎丸！
Content.LocalizedString: Aren't you useful sometimes, Kiroumaru!

Content.SourceString: 嗯……搞不懂，带回去让娜娜莉和呆子看看算了。
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… can't figure it out, let's take it back for Nanally and the dummy.

Content.SourceString: 喔！好东西啊~感觉可以用这个去逗逗娜娜莉~
Content.LocalizedString: Oh! Nice find! Nanally's going to react funny!

Content.SourceString: 敢把这个吃掉你就死定了！（鬼郎丸：呃——）
Content.LocalizedString: You're dead if you eat this! (Kiroumaru: Ugh…)

Content.SourceString: 把这玩意拿给浔的话……
Content.LocalizedString: If I give this to Hotori…

Content.SourceString: 今天运气不错呢！
Content.LocalizedString: My lucky day!

Content.SourceString: 呜……有点疼……
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh… it hurts a bit…

Content.SourceString: 令人讨厌的感觉……
Content.LocalizedString: I don't like this…

Content.SourceString: 才不会那么轻易地退场！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not going away this easily!

Content.SourceString: 哼，我可不止这个程度！
Content.LocalizedString: Hmph, I'm more than this!

Content.SourceString: ……怎么会……
Content.LocalizedString: …How could it be…
…I see…
…You… dare…

Content.SourceString: 有倒霉蛋被砸扁咯~
Content.LocalizedString: Some unlucky soul got crushed!

Content.SourceString: 轻轻松松~
Content.LocalizedString: Piece of cake!

Content.SourceString: 有一手嘛！
Content.LocalizedString: Not bad!

Content.SourceString: 给我等着！
Content.LocalizedString: Wait and see!

Content.SourceString: 唔……我要砸扁你！（吃掉！）
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh… I'm gonna crush you! (Eat!)

Content.SourceString: ……你会后悔的！
Content.LocalizedString: …You'll regret this!

Content.SourceString: 一起去大闹一场吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Let's make a scene together!

Content.SourceString: 鬼郎丸，这下允许你放开肚皮吃。
Content.LocalizedString: Kiroumaru, now you may eat!

Content.SourceString: 起飞咯！
Content.LocalizedString: Taking off!

Content.SourceString: 看这边！
Content.LocalizedString: Over here!

Content.SourceString: 鬼郎丸冲击~
Content.LocalizedString: Kiroumaru Overdrive!

Content.SourceString: 慢吞吞的……
Content.LocalizedString: So slow…

Content.SourceString: 鬼郎丸别乱动，掉下去了我可不管！
Content.LocalizedString: Kiroumaru, stop squirming around! I'm not helping you if you fall!

Content.SourceString: 让一让——
Content.LocalizedString: Coming through!

Content.SourceString: 鬼来捉人咯！
Content.LocalizedString: Tag, you're it!

Content.SourceString: 开吃~
Content.LocalizedString: Time to eat!

Content.SourceString: 去去，让早雾大人来！
Content.LocalizedString: Move aside! Let the great Sakiri handle this!

Content.SourceString: 在后面做好支援就行了，呆子。
Content.LocalizedString: Stay back and help, dummy.

Content.SourceString: 好，好，一代目——
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah, yeah, Ichi-whatever.

Content.SourceString: 别总把我当小孩看。
Content.LocalizedString: Stop treating me like a child.

Content.SourceString: 总算该我上了。
Content.LocalizedString: My turn!

Content.SourceString: 注意注意，鬼郎丸来了！
Content.LocalizedString: Watch out, watch out! It's Kiroumaru!

Content.SourceString: 昨天喝大了就别强撑着！
Content.LocalizedString: Stay out of this if you're drunk!

Content.SourceString: 往后站点，埃德嘉！
Content.LocalizedString: Get back, Edgar!

Content.SourceString: 都说了别闷着头往前……
Content.LocalizedString: I'm telling you… You can't just charge forward.

Content.SourceString: 老胳膊老腿了就别逞强了。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't try too hard, old man.

Content.SourceString: 你怎么会犯这种错……
Content.LocalizedString: No way you made a mistake like that…

Content.SourceString: 坏家伙，你不会以为我们鉴定师很好欺负吧？！
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, baddies, do you think our Appraiser is a pushover?

Content.SourceString: 早就注意到了！
Content.LocalizedString: I knew it!

Content.SourceString: 轮到我了！
Content.LocalizedString: My turn!

Content.SourceString: 还没鬼郎丸动作快。
Content.LocalizedString: Kiroumaru is faster than this!

Content.SourceString: 怎么打不着呢~
Content.LocalizedString: Heh, another miss?
